in_hebrew.name: יאליריא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יְהוָה אוֹר מִצִּיוֹן יְאַלִירִיא (יהוה אור מציון יאליריא) – this name is derived from the Hebrew words 'יהוה' (YHWH) meaning 'God', 'אור' (aur) meaning 'light' and 'מציון' (mitsyon) meaning 'from Zion'. So, Jallier means 'God is my light from Zion'.

in_greek.name: Ιαλλιεριος
in_greek.long_meaning: An ancient Greek name, Ιαλλιεριος (Iallerios), is derived from the Greek words 'ιαλλο' (iallo) meaning 'light' and 'εριος' (eros) meaning 'mountain'. So, Jallerios means 'Mountain of light'.

in_latin.name: Iallerius
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the ancient Greek name Ιαλλιεριος (Iallerios).
